Definition: from G613; secret; by implication, treasured:--hid, kept secret.
BiblicalUsage: Hidden, kept secret, treasured away. In Christ are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge, says Colossians 2:3 — hidden not to be kept from us, but kept for us. Jesus promises the reverse in Luke 8:17 and Mark 4:22: nothing is secret that shall not be made manifest, neither anything hid that shall not be known and come abroad.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two uses belong together. What God hides, He hides in Christ, where seeking finds it; what men hide, God will bring abroad, where nothing stays covered. The word warns me twice: seek the treasure where it is hid, and never trust a secret to stay secret.
